title: T6 Sub-agent and fork cost accounting plus parity guard and AGENTS.md rule
description: Depends on T4 and spike T2. Files: conversation/src/turn/finalize.ts (walk every conversation of the session, not only root.entries), conversation/src/storage/indexed-storage.ts queries as needed, structural vitest guard under conversation/test listing every model call site against a metered allowlist, AGENTS.md one-line rule (a feature that creates conversations, calls a model or moves a session carries cost accounting in the same PR). Acceptance: plan scenarios 14, 15, 16 pass; the guard fails when an unmetered completeSimple or streamSimple caller is added.
right_now_summary: T6 will add cost accounting for sub-agents and forks, with tests and a guard for unmetered model calls.
